title: Heavy Rainfall Triggers Landslides, Blocks Geyzing-Legship Road In Sikkim
description: According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), Geyzing recorded 95.2 mm of rainfall during the past 24 hours. District Magistrate of Geyzing, Tenzing Denzongpa, said information about the landslide was received at around 9 pm on Tuesday.
